root_family.definition: Handmade processional brass and wooden crosses (Lalibela, Gondar, Axum), traditional parchment paintings, and historical numismatics.

translations.am: የጥበብ ስራዎች፣ የእጅ ጥበብ እና ቅርሶች (መስቀሎች)
translations.or: Hojii Aartii, Aadaa fi Qabeenya Seenaa
translations.ti: ስነ ጥበብ፣ ናይ ኢድ ጥበባትን ቅርስታትን (መስቀላት)

children.definition: Lost-wax cast brass, silver, and carved olive-wood hand, neck, and processional crosses.

translations.am: የእጅ እና የብር መስቀሎች (የላሊበላ፣ የአክሱም መስቀል)
